description: Queues the free report for the building resolved with resolve_building and returns a private link (previewUrl) and a statusToken for get_report_status. The free report is a blurred web preview without PDF; it is generated in minutes. CONSENT: before calling, show the person the consent text returned by get_products (consent.text, same language) with its terms and privacy links, and set consent=true only if the person has explicitly accepted it in this conversation; pass consent.statementSha256 as consentStatementSha256. Never accept on the person's behalf. The email is optional (ready notice; at most 2 free reports per email every 14 days) and only with the person's permission. The link is private: give it only to the person, never publish it. Always tell the person: it is a preliminary, automated report built from public records, not a technical inspection, valuation, certificate, safety assessment or legal advice; probabilities are given as words (very low to very high), never as percentages; a check without data (○) means unknown, not negative or safe; Navarra is not covered yet; the report is only available as a private link.

consent.description: true only if the person explicitly accepted the consent text from get_products.

consentStatementSha256.description: consent.statementSha256 from get_products for the same language.

email.description: Optional email of the person for the ready notice, only with their permission.

language.description: Language of the report and of the texts: es, en, de, nl or fr. Default es. Must be the language of the consent text shown.

title: Create the free HOUSINGFAX report (private link)
